risk_if_not_implemented: Without Alternate Storage Site, data, software and system images cannot be reliably restored within required recovery objectives following a disruption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Data Loss / Integrity Compromise (R-BC-2), Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), Concentration / Single-Point Dependency Failure (R-OR-2), Loss of Data / Service Availability (R-IP-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; Hazardous Materials Emergencies (MT-3), Nuclear, Biological and Chemical (NBC) Weapons (MT-4), Physical Crime (MT-5), Terrorism & Armed Attacks (MT-6).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Backups
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to create recurring backups of data, software and/or system images, as well as verify the integrity of these backups, to ensure the availability of the data to satisfy Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Backups (BCD-24) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Alternate Storage Site (BCD-12) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Alternate Processing Site
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to establish an alternate processing site that provides processing capability and security measures equivalent to that of the primary site.
compensating_control_2.justification: Alternate Processing Site (BCD-13) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Alternate Storage Site (BCD-12) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
